user.title: Connect to the Haushalttickets server
user.description: The installer printed the API token once. The server only accepts Home Assistant if its address is listed in ALLOWED_CLIENTS.

data_description.api_token: Created on the server with haushalttickets-ctl token create

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The server at {url} rejected the token. Create a new one on the server and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: The server cannot be reached or is not a Haushalttickets server.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the API token.
error.client_not_allowed: The server does not accept connections from this Home Assistant. Add its address to ALLOWED_CLIENTS in /etc/haushalttickets/server.env.
error.invalid_url: Enter a URL such as http://192.168.1.20:8080.

invalid_auth.message: The Haushalttickets server rejected the API token.

cannot_connect.message: The Haushalttickets server cannot be reached: {error}

update_failed.message: Updating from the Haushalttickets server failed: {error}

not_loaded.message: Haushalttickets is not set up or not loaded.

person_without_user.message: {entity_id} is not linked to a Home Assistant user.

reserved_fields.message: Set these through their own options, not extra_fields: {fields}

user_not_found.message: No Home Assistant user is named {user}.

user_ambiguous.message: Several Home Assistant users are named {user}; give the user ID.

create_ticket.name: Create ticket
create_ticket.description: Creates a ticket. Started by a person, it is filed for that person; started by an automation, for the user Automation.

urgency.name: Urgency
urgency.description: How soon it must be done.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: Date by which it should be done.

assignees.name: Assignees
assignees.description: Persons responsible; each must be linked to a user.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: Area concerned (repairs and Home Assistant work).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device concerned (repairs and Home Assistant work).

extra_fields.name: Extra fields
extra_fields.description: Further ticket fields of the server API, for example price_estimated or vendor for purchases.

set_status.name: Set status
set_status.description: Moves a ticket to another status.

add_comment.name: Add comment
add_comment.description: Adds a comment to a ticket.

assign.name: Assign
assign.description: Replaces the assignees of a ticket.

assignees.name: Assignees
assignees.description: Persons responsible; each must be linked to a user.

set_role.name: Set role
set_role.description: Sets the role of a household member in the ticket system: give a person, or a user without person (such as the AI account) by name. Home Assistant admins only; the server also requires its admin role.

person.name: Person
person.description: Person linked to the user. Leave empty when you give a user.

user.name: User
user.description: Name or ID of a Home Assistant user without person, for example the AI account.

role.name: Role
role.description: Adults approve purchases, children may only file and accept their own tickets, the AI agent follows the AI rules.

send_due_reminders.name: Send due reminders
send_due_reminders.description: Sends each household member one notification listing their open tickets that are overdue, due today or due tomorrow (assignees, or the requester when nobody is assigned). Delivered as haushalttickets_notification events.
